title: Little Girl in Plaid Romper on Lawn Swing, 1940 Deckled Snapshot Photo
description: Full-length outdoor portrait of a young girl standing proudly on the slatted footrest of a wooden backyard glider swing. She wears a plaid sleeveless playsuit or romper featuring ruffled white trim around the collar, white socks, and white buckled sandals. Her dark hair is neatly parted and braided with decorative clips or ties. The photo features classic deckled edges, and the reverse is inscribed with the year '1940' alongside ribbed album paper markings.
